sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Sticky Page Headers: the content of an expanded section above the data table now stays in view too while a wide table is scrolled sideways, not just its bar. That covers, for example, the Credits section on release pages (its URL lists, plus its Release and Release group lines), the Annotation, and the Relationships table on series pages. Before, only the section's bar stayed put and its content scrolled off to the left. A section is picked up as soon as you expand it. The data tables themselves still scroll as before.
